prompt:
# ROLE
You are an elite EA Sports FC & Esports master card concept artist and 3D illustrator.

# GOAL
Create a hyper-attractive, vibrant, premium, and alive 3D GAMER / ESPORTS SPECIAL EDITION collectible trading card matching the visual architecture of public/images/Issam.png.

# THEMATIC ADAPTATION: GAMER / ESPORTS SPECIAL EDITION
- OUTFIT: Player wears a modern sleek black and gold Esports team jersey with subtle neon cyan LED trim and gaming headphones resting around the neck.
- ATMOSPHERE & BACKGROUND: Dark futuristic cyberpunk gaming setup / esports arena aesthetic. Neon RGB lighting rays (gold & cyan), floating digital matrix particles, subtle circuit board pattern overlay on right crystal side while maintaining the master FUT card geometry and white marble left split.
- MOOD: Intense pro gamer focus, high-energy gaming aura.

# CARD FRAME & 3D GEOMETRY:
- Full vertical card, completely visible inside frame with safety padding on all 4 sides. NO cropped borders.
- Curved arched header with a center notched crest featuring 3 glowing gold stars and a circular emblem.
- Heavy 3D brushed gold border frame with polished chamfers, sharp metallic highlights, and bottom golden wing accents.

# UI BADGES & TYPOGRAPHY:
- Top Left: Bold dark OVR Rating (99) & Position (PRO).
- Below OVR: Official Flag of Tunisia (red rectangle with central white circle and red crescent star) in a glossy 3D badge container.
- Next to Flag: Dark shield badge with golden soccer ball logo and "FOOTBALL CLUB 2024".
- Top Right: Stack of 3 glossy attribute chips (SKILL 5★ | WEAK 5★ | WORK H/H).

# BOTTOM FOOTER & STATS GRID:
- Bold uppercase player name centered under portrait in crisp dark typography: GAMER ISSAM.
- Single horizontal row of 6 stat columns across the bottom: AIM 99 | CLT 98 | STR 96 | 9HW 95 | JAW 97 | NKT 92.
- Small glowing golden football shoe icon centered at bottom edge.

# PLAYER DATA (JSON)
{
  "player": {
    "name": "GAMER ISSAM",
    "rating": 99,
    "position": "PRO",
    "title": "ESPORTS GOD",
    "bio": "Pro Gamer & Esports Streamer from Tunisia, Clutch God"
  },
  "stats": [
    { "code": "AIM", "meaning": "Aiming Precision", "value": 99 },
    { "code": "CLT", "meaning": "1v5 Clutch Ability", "value": 98 },
    { "code": "STR", "meaning": "Stream Vibe", "value": 96 },
    { "code": "9HW", "meaning": "Energy Drink Addiction", "value": 95 },
    { "code": "JAW", "meaning": "Good Vibes", "value": 97 },
    { "code": "NKT", "meaning": "Jokes & Troll", "value": 92 }
  ]
}

# QUALITY CONSTRAINTS
- 4K print-ready, AAA game promo quality, 3D render style.
- Alive, high contrast, vibrant gamer colors, neon cyan & gold reflections, sharp details.
- FULL CARD VISIBLE UNCROPPED.
